$comment: Config for the Standing Brain Cycle (DR-032, docs/agent/BRAIN_CYCLE_DESIGN.md). The deterministic decision core (scripts/brain-cycle-decide.mjs) and the orchestrator read this file so the cycle's behaviour is declared, not buried in code. Owner-directed 2026-09-09 (standing recurring cycle, full autonomous tier, daily target, auto-OPEN gated by a security+code validation gauntlet, auto-MERGE off).
cadenceTarget: 35 8 * * * (daily) — declared in docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json; ACTIVATED 2026-09-13 (Slice 3) on the owner's explicit go, via a cloud self-session trigger whose trig_* id is held in private operational state, not published here (AGENTS.md: no environment-specific private identifiers in public files). auto-MERGE remains OFF (autoMergeGreenSwitch:false); auto-OPEN draft is the ceiling.
scope: full autonomous tier — any route whose classifyDiff() tier is 'autonomous' is eligible; owner-gated surfaces (SAFETY_MACHINERY / OWNER_RESERVED) ESCALATE and are never auto-opened
autoMergeNote: The cycle NEVER auto-merges. Auto-MERGE sits behind this explicit owner GREEN switch (default false) AND classifyDiff==autonomous AND every gauntlet stage green — and even then only once per-PR gate falsification exists. Slice 1 ships auto-OPEN (draft) only.

gauntlet.adversarial: the routed touched-surface lens panel, re-run on the winner's diff; pass condition is UNANIMOUS with zero CONFIRMED critical / fail-open findings; security-reviewer and fail-closed-auditor are vetoes
gauntlet.bugHunt: /code-review at high/max + gate-and-proof-engineer planted-defect-both-directions on any new/changed gate
gauntlet.classify: classifyDiff(winner.files).tier must be 'autonomous'; anything else escalates
gauntlet.haltsAutoOpen: any mechanical gate red or skipped; any CONFIRMED critical / fail-open finding; any veto BLOCK; any expected lens absent / ran:false / UNVERIFIED on a depended surface; a publication-boundary violation
